options.opa: It binds to the 30S subunit and inhibits the binding of aminoacyl-tRNA.
options.opb: Inhibits the peptidyltransferase activity of the 50S ribosomal subunit.
options.opc: It binds to the 50S ribosomal subunit and inhibits translocation.
options.opd: It inhibits the initiation and originates an erroneous reading of the mRNA.
options.ope: It causes premature termination by acting as an analog of the aminoacyl-tRNA.
